content: पौरुषेय {%a.%} (-यी|{%f.%}) [पुरुष-ठञ्] .²1 Derived from or belonging to man, human, incidental to man; made, established or propounded by man; as in अपौरुषेया वै वेदाः. .²2 Manly, virile. .²3 Spiritual. .{@-यः@} .²1 Manslaughter (पुरुषवध). .²2 A crowd of men. .²3 A day-labourer, hireling. .²4 Human action, manʼs work. .²5 Law as affecting persons. .{@-यम्@} Human work, action of man.
